What guests come for

From what guests write on Google.

Meze to share

Many small dishes for the table. Guests write that the staff help you order just the right amount.

Grill and classics

Halloumi, lamb chops, pork souvlaki, calamari, octopus and a moussaka that guests call anything but standard.

Waffles and cakes

Waffles with fresh fruit and ice cream, carrot cake and orange pie. The café also has its own ice cream shop.

Drinks all day

Coffee, smoothies, fresh lemonade and cocktails. Google counts twelve reviews about the smoothies.

Live music

Google counts 14 reviews that mention live music. Guests write that it is not too loud.

Good for families

Options for everyone

A modern kafeneio

Beatriz describes itself as a modern gastro kafeneio in the old town of Paphos. It is at Konstantinou Kanari 36, in a two-storey house with green window boxes and a white awning that reads Beatriz Cafe Bistro. The tables stand outside on the pedestrian street, under trees and next to a wall of colourful woven rings.

What guests say

Three of 570 Google reviews, 474 of them with five stars.

“Exceptional food, real Cypriot meze cuisine with modern vibe. The service outstanding and the owner is incredibly hospitable. If you are in Paphos old town, this is not a place to miss!”

Google review
